name: sur-candes
review: System (5), empirical coefficient law and fixed-coordinate null LRT; below the MLE existence boundary, Gaussian design and signal moment conditions.

name: existence
review: Asymptotic separability phase boundary; no finite-sample iff or solver-status criterion. The no-intercept boundary integrates out Z analytically.

name: covariance
review: Gaussian arbitrary-covariance coefficient inference uses conditional predictor scales, not arbitrary non-Gaussian universality.

name: cgmt
review: Theorem II.1: compact admissible sets, convexity for two-sided value comparison, growth/gap condition for minimizer norms; unbounded sets require localization.

name: rf
review: Assumptions 1-3 and Theorem 2: spherical input/weight model, activation moments and target/noise hypotheses. Gaussian equivalence concerns limiting risks, not an identity for each feature.

name: mest
review: Optimal M-estimation under Gaussian design and error/loss assumptions; effective noise convolution and proximal loss construction.

name: sloe
review: SLOE estimates corrupted predictor variance eta^2 through leave-one-out predictions, then reparameterizes the scalar system. Numerical examples here use oracle known gamma, not an implemented SLOE estimate.
